itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.title: CachyOS — Blazingly Fast OS based on Arch Linux — CachyOS
itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.snippet: CachyOS ships every package optimized for your CPU - compiled with x86-64-v3/v4 and Zen4 instructions, LTO, and PGO - on top of a custom kernel with the tuned EEVDF scheduler. The result: a noticeably faster Arch Linux experience with the same rolling-release flexibility you expect.
